text:
liz: Heads-up — saw a Dedicated EU pool (eu-dedicated-3) autoscale bump at ~11:08 UTC and some requests started queuing. Does anyone know which saturation signal actually tripped? I can't find the cross-correlation graph for cpu vs kvcache-miss-rate. /cc @ben @priya

ben: I think the primary measured signal is `pool_saturation_score`. Grafana has a panel under Infra -> Dedicated Pools -> Saturation Correlations. quick link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/dedicated-pools?var-pool=eu-dedicated-3 :point_right:

ben: quick PromQL we use to compute the score (simplified):
```
(sum by (pool) (rate(requests_queueing_total[5m])) / max_over_time(pool_capacity_gpu[5m])) * 0.6 + avg_over_time(p95_latency_ms[5m]) * 0.4
```

priya: also watch kvcache miss spikes — Loki query: ` {app="inference", pool="eu-dedicated-3"} |= "kvcache_miss" ` then group by 1m. I saw a spike at 11:07 which lines up with queueing.

sam: FYI the autoscaler policy weights queue_length and tail latency. There's a separate panel that shows autoscale decisions (replica count timeline) next to saturation_score. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/autoscale/decisions?var-pool=eu-dedicated-3

liz: thanks — can someone paste the alert threshold? The alert fired but I want to confirm if it's too sensitive.

ben: alert name is `DedicatedPoolSaturationHigh`. Expr: `pool_saturation_score > 0.7` for 3m. We had a discussion to bump to 0.8 last week but the PR didn't land (PR #3456). :face_with_monocle:

priya: i just pushed a comment on that PR — if we agree, I'll open a quick follow-up to raise threshold to 0.8 and add the kvcache overlay panel Liz asked for.

autoscaler-bot: [autoscaler] scale up executed for pool=eu-dedicated-3 replicas:+2 (6 -> 8) at 2026-07-04T11:09:24Z :robot_face:

liz: perfect. Can we also add a tiny correlation panel (saturation_score vs kvcache_miss_rate) with a 5m rolling window so it's easy to eyeball future incidents?

sam: yup — I'll add that by EOD. Panel query will be something like:
```
series1: avg_over_time(pool_saturation_score[5m])
series2: increase(kvcache_miss_total[5m]) / 5m
```

ben: when you add it, please pin it to the pool-level dashboard and drop a link here. :thumbsup:

liz: thanks all — this helps. will follow up if i see more noise tonight. :eyes:
